name: PeerPush

sources.title: PeerPush homepage + FAQ — free queue, paid instant-publish tiers, structured data for AI discovery

conditions: Free submissions join a publishing queue (no stated wait length); paid plans publish instantly
requirements: Structured product data model: use cases, audiences, platforms, pricing, alternatives — fill these for AI-search visibility
Community-engagement scoring (PeerPush score from upvotes/comments/shares/mutual support) drives directory visibility
preparation: URL for AI auto-fill of product details (or manual entry)
Use cases, target audiences, platforms (Web/iOS/Android/MCP), pricing, alternatives, screenshots, description
Plan choice: Free queue / Basic $39 instant publish / Boosted $89 (7-day promotion, 20k+ impressions) / Max-Boosted $229 (30-day, 100k+ impressions)
workflow: Click 'Submit Your Product' — provide URL for AI auto-fill or enter details manually
Complete structured fields (use cases, audiences, platforms, pricing, alternatives, screenshots)
Free: wait in the publishing queue; Paid: publish instantly
Earn PeerPush score via engagement to compete for Product of Day/Week/Month Hall of Fame
watchFor: Free queue length is unstated — paid Basic ($39) is the only documented instant route
Boosted/Max-Boosted are promotion packages (impressions), not just listing upgrades
Strong agent surface: MCP server and public API exist for AI integration
'Submit to 100 directories' banner links a separate done-for-you submission service — optional upsell
Site advertises 10.8M AI-assistant reads/30d and 1.08M monthly visitors — self-reported
countsAsLive: Product page live in the PeerPush directory (searchable via category/use-case browse), accruing upvotes/comments and PeerPush score
